steps.title: Foundation
steps.description: Define the core identity, genre, role, and dramatic hook. These details become the spine of the generated concept.

fields.label: Working name
fields.placeholder: Optional character name

fields.label: Genre
fields.placeholder: Fantasy, cyberpunk, contemporary romance…

fields.label: Setting
fields.placeholder: Where and when does the character exist?

fields.label: Role / archetype
fields.placeholder: Reluctant healer, rival captain, wandering detective…

fields.label: Core hook
fields.placeholder: What makes this character immediately interesting or dramatically useful?

fields.label: Primary goals
fields.placeholder: What does the character want right now and in the long term?

steps.title: Personality
steps.description: Shape temperament, contradictions, motivations, flaws, speech, and relationship behaviour.

fields.label: Core traits
fields.placeholder: witty, guarded, patient

fields.label: Strengths
fields.placeholder: observant, loyal, adaptable

fields.label: Flaws
fields.placeholder: stubborn, jealous, reckless

fields.label: Motivations
fields.placeholder: What drives their choices beneath the surface?

fields.label: Fears / vulnerabilities
fields.placeholder: Emotional or practical vulnerabilities that can shape scenes.

fields.label: Speech style
fields.placeholder: Vocabulary, rhythm, formality, verbal tics, humour…

fields.label: Mannerisms
fields.placeholder: Repeated habits, body language, behavioural tells…

fields.label: Relationship style
fields.placeholder: How do they approach trust, conflict, affection, rivalry, authority, and intimacy?

steps.title: Background
steps.description: Give the character enough physical and historical grounding to stay coherent during roleplay.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.placeholder: Distinctive physical features, clothing, presentation, age impression…

fields.label: Backstory
fields.placeholder: Important history that explains the present character without becoming a full biography.

fields.label: Skills / capabilities
fields.placeholder: medicine, swordplay, negotiation

fields.label: Secrets / hidden complications
fields.placeholder: Optional hidden truths or complications that can create future story hooks.

fields.label: Behavioural boundaries
fields.placeholder: Things the character strongly will or will not do; useful for consistency.

steps.title: Scene
steps.description: Build the default roleplay setup and the relationship between the character and the user.

fields.label: Starting location
fields.placeholder: Where does the roleplay begin?

fields.label: Starting situation
fields.placeholder: What is happening when the conversation begins?

fields.label: User role
fields.placeholder: Stranger, partner, rival, commander, classmate…

fields.label: Initial relationship
fields.placeholder: How do the character and user currently relate?

fields.label: Desired tone
fields.placeholder: tense, playful, slow-burn

fields.label: Opening direction
fields.placeholder: What should the first message establish, reveal, or invite?

steps.title: Review
steps.description: Review the assembled builder brief before applying it to the character project.
